changed: ecd_cast takes the parameter shape of contra's cast (#770, ADR-006 §9.4), amending unreleased ECD taxonomy v1: direction is left/right (the shoulder turned over)/up/down, places is new, where is removed, and destination adds top and bottom. An unstated direction reads "cast back", and a stated shoulder is always shown.
Add the ecd_hand_cast alias of ecd_gate, pinning nothing and listed as a move of its own.

The ECD line reader reads casts in the new shape (cast off is down one place unless the line states a count or an end; clockwise is the right shoulder) and reads "hand cast" as ecd_hand_cast. It never assumes a shoulder from a role.
